text:
maria: Quick check — we're planning to announce Dedicated autoscale features tomorrow 9:00 AM PT. Need final changelog URL, docs link, and canary rollout window. Also webinar registration link + UTMs? @raj @sam @alex
raj: changelog is up: https://redwood.ai/changelog/dedicated-autoscale (live). Canary window planned 9:30 AM PT → 11:30 AM PT: 10% traffic first 30m, then 50% next 60m, full rollout by ~3h. Fallback policy -> smaller quantized variant.
sam: docs PR merged and examples updated. Docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/dedicated/autoscale-beta. Heads-up: API example currently shows `x-retry` header; if marketing copy claims no retries we should remove that.
alex: please keep embargo at 9:00 AM PT — press asked for 9:05 release timing. Messaging: call out "up to 2.5x throughput" but avoid absolute statements until perf report is final.
jen: inbound lead routing question — can we ensure webinar/reg links include `utm_campaign=dedicated-autoscale` and enterprise leads are routed to AE queue automatically? Need to prep AEs.
raj: UTMs ✅. Enterprise routing plan: domain-match -> AE queue via Zapier webhook; others -> SDR flow. I can add an `x-customer-segment` header in the webhook payload for downstream filters.
deploy-bot: [deploy queued] prod rollout job #8345 scheduled for 2026-04-01 09:30:00 PT — will trigger canary per config.
maria: Can someone paste a short changelog blurb we can copy into the blog and press one-pager (one paragraph)?
raj: Changelog blurb: "Dedicated autoscale introduces predictable GPU pools with policy-driven autoscaling, burst capacity, and SLA-backed latency targets. It includes rolling canaries, model fallback paths, and observability hooks for per-route cost and latency breakdowns." Edit as needed for tone.
sam: Blog sample request updated — example curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"dedicated-autoscale","input":"Generate a summary"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`
alex: one copy ask — avoid saying "zero downtime" in any copy. Use "minimal service disruption" or "graceful degradation" instead.
maria: Great — I'll draft the blog + press one-pager and post for review by 5:00 PM PT today. Will attach final changelog snippet and docs links. Any blockers?
jen: Confirm AE routing is live before noon so AEs can see test leads.
raj: I'll enable the AE routing rule by 11:30 AM PT and smoke-test with a sample lead.
maria: Thanks team :thumbsup:
